tiebreakers.description: More AP from the Development board
More Artisans; still tied = shared victory

notes: family: worker-placement-ap (tile and track sums, no end-game majorities). Verified against the official English rulebook: AP = Construction tiles + Development board (Technology and Reputation tracks) + Manager cards in hand and on player board + unused Upgrade tokens (1 each) + Artisans (3 each); Research department AP track final value = farthest unlocked slot. Game ends after Audit of round 3. Tiebreakers in order: more completed Construction boards, more AP from Development board, more Artisans, then shared. AP printed on tiles, cards and track slots are scorer inputs. Year not verified.
